translation.dataStaysLocal: Your data stays on your device
translation.onboardingSubtitle: You are about to begin a journey that has no wrong notes.
translation.onboardingBody: This guided orientation will help you set your pace. Everything is optional.
translation.tensionEnemy: Bertrand teaches that tension is the enemy of music.
translation.breathingIntro: We can begin with three slow breaths to ground your body before practice. This takes 18 seconds. You are free to skip this at any time.
translation.breathingToolsPortal: You can always find breathing tools in The Player portal.
translation.breathsComplete: Three breaths complete. Your body is ready.
translation.choosePath: How would you like to walk this path?
translation.choosePathSubtitle: Choose the pace that fits your life. You can change this anytime.
translation.threeOriginalSongsGoal: Your goal: compose and perform three original songs.
translation.goalRootSub: After Chapter 4 — your first song, from the heart
translation.goalBridgeSub: After Chapter 8 — a melody from your imagination
translation.goalReturnSub: After Chapter 12 — a free performance, no stopping
translation.feedbackLogged: Logged locally · Email sent to Joshua
translation.errorHiccup: Something unexpected happened. Take a breath — this is just a technical hiccup, not a wrong note.
translation.onboardingModalBody: A whole-person guitar academy built on 12 frets, 12 intervals, and one transformative teaching method by Bertrand Laurence.
translation.onboardingModalDetail: Learn to play guitar by learning to listen.
translation.startingFretBody: Every student starts at the chapter that matches their experience. You can change this anytime.
translation.readyBody: The red guitar icon (top-left) opens your personal AI companion. It knows your level, speaks with you, and guides your journey.
translation.readyDetail: Tap the blue book anytime → Library → "How This Works" for the full guided tour.
translation.binderHint: Blue book widget (top-right) → Library → "How This Works"
translation.privateLessons: Private lessons · Async coaching · Inner Circle
translation.adventureSubtitle: A musical story where singing the right notes unlocks the next chapter
translation.adventureContinue: Continue from where you left off
translation.advSkipCoaching: No worries — you can always come back to practice this pitch later.
translation.mentorSubtitle: Review student practice, check pitch accuracy, and prepare helpful feedback offline.
translation.selectStudent: Select a student submission to review:
translation.noSubmissions: No student submissions found in local database.
translation.practiceToolsSubtitle: Your 12 practice tools — one per chapter.
translation.recordPlingDesc: Record a 2-minute audio clip of yourself singing the minor 3rd interval and finding it on the A string.
translation.feedbackQuote: "Your transition from the C-shape to the A-shape is much smoother. Keep watching that left thumb."
translation.socraticDeskDesc: Analyze student video for pitch accuracy and prepare AI practice feedback.
translation.selectVideo: Select a practice video to extract pitch metrics, run AI analysis, and build helpful feedback.
translation.coachingPackagesDesc: Highly interactive personal coaching packages blending Bertrand's unique techniques, real-time pitch feedback, and fun practice tracking tools.
translation.intakeFormDesc: This intake form helps Bertrand customize your practice routines. You can optionally scan your focus baseline using the webcam tool below.
translation.intakeSubmittedDesc: Your intake details have been logged in Bertrand's local SQLite database. He will review your profile and contact you for scheduling shortly.
translation.practiceGoals: Your Practice Goals (Guitar styles, favorite songs)
translation.practiceGoalsPlaceholder: Ex. Master chord transitions, learn fingerstyle, release neck strain...
translation.focusScanDesc: Use your webcam to check your focus and relaxation levels before submitting.
translation.telemetryDesc: Review practice sessions, pitch stability improvements, and focus statistics over the course of the lessons.
translation.autonomicTrendsDesc: Tracks your focus and relaxation progress during your practice sessions.
translation.connectForSongwriting: Connect the Voix Vive Desktop App to unlock AI songwriting. The Quill uses your local LLM to generate personalized lyrics from your practice data.
translation.themePlaceholder: e.g. my first song, the stars, the journey...
translation.simulationMode: Simulation mode · BLE & rPPG hardware coming soon
translation.emptyJournal: Your journal is empty. Complete a tool session to write your first reflection.
translation.ve_studyGoldDots: Study the gold dots below — they show where the notes are on the fretboard.
translation.ve_studyPattern: Study the pattern! You have a few seconds before it disappears.
translation.ve_patternVanished: The pattern just vanished — get ready to tap!
translation.ve_tapNotes: Tap where the notes were — trust your imagination!
translation.ve_howToPlayImagine: ❶ Study the gold dots — they show notes in the scale. ❷ Tap the same positions. ❸ Hold and breathe steadily until the timer completes.
translation.ve_howToPlayFlash: ❶ Gold dots flash on the fretboard — study positions! ❷ The pattern disappears. ❸ Tap from memory. ❹ Green = correct, Red = wrong, Orange = missed.
translation.ve_menuSubtitle: Train the imagination. The fingers follow.
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc1: A vertiscale is a vertical scale shape on the guitar neck. Instead of playing a scale horizontally (across frets), you play it vertically (across strings in the same fret area).
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc2: This teaches you to see patterns in all directions — the foundation of fretboard mastery.
translation.ve_vertiscaleDesc3: Don’t worry if you’re new — the game starts simple (just 2 strings) and gradually adds more.
translation.ve_slowDesc: Pattern stays 3.5s — focus on physical memory
translation.ve_innerFretboardDesc: Train your visual memory of where notes live on the guitar neck
translation.ve_flashDesc: A pattern of notes flashes on the fretboard. Study it carefully — then it disappears! Tap from your imagination to recreate where the notes were.
translation.ve_imagineDesc: The pattern stays visible while you place your taps. Focus on accuracy and steady breathing.
translation.ve_innerEarDesc: Develop your ability to hear and match pitches
translation.ve_audiateDesc: A note falls down the screen. Try to hear it in your mind first, then sing it.
translation.ve_innerVoiceDesc: Reflect on what your practice sessions reveal
translation.ve_reflectDesc: Review your session performance. See where you were accurate, where you struggled, and journal about what you noticed.
translation.ve_livingStoryDesc: Learn through an immersive historical narrative
translation.ve_adventureDesc: Play through a historical story as a medieval truebadour. At key moments, you must match a musical pitch to unlock the next chapter.
translation.ve_hearInMind: Hear the note in your mind. Don’t sing yet…
translation.ve_fhealPlaceholder:
What did your hands remember that your mind forgot?
Where was the gap between imagination and reality?
What surprised you?
translation.manifestoTagline: Welcome to the Voix Vive Academy.
translation.manifestoHook: A step-by-step 12-chapter journey to master the guitar.
translation.manifestoBody: Voix Vive is a modern way to learn guitar. Master chords, train your ear, and build your confidence.
translation.manifestoFreeBadge: 12 chapters · 211 lessons · practice tools · Truebadour AI — all free
translation.signInToSaveProgress: Sign in to save your progress across all your devices
translation.privateMentorshipCercle: Private mentorship · Video critique · Inner Circle
translation.help_isomorphic_desc: The curriculum matches each note on the guitar to specific exercises that build physical and musical skills.
translation.help_bedoplay_desc: A simple 3-step loop: listen to the music, practice the technique, and then play it yourself.
translation.help_truebadour_desc: Your personal practice companion. The AI guide listens to your pitch and helps you stay on track.
translation.help_slowweb_desc: Designed for focus. No infinite scrolling or annoying notifications, so you can just practice.
translation.help_symbiosis_desc: The AI provides 24/7 practice feedback, while Bertrand Laurence provides deeper guidance through video reviews and live sessions.
translation.help_sandbox_desc: Controlled non-linear exploration. Wander freely without affecting your core progression gates.
translation.help_bilingual_desc: Full English/French support. Toggle language anytime with the button in the header.
translation.pr_instruction: Record up to 90 seconds of your practice. Bertrand will review and send personalized feedback within 48 hours.
translation.pr_previewInstruction: Review your recording. When you're happy, submit it for Bertrand's feedback.
translation.pr_willReview: Bertrand will review your practice and send personalized video feedback within 48 hours. Check your Binder for updates.
translation.spr_guidedPracticeDesc: A structured session with breathing, warm-up, practice, free play, and reflection. Recorded and saved to your Google Drive.
translation.spr_savedDriveDesc: Saved to your Google Drive after session.
translation.spr_localRecordingDesc: Sign in later to save to Google Drive. Local recording works now.
translation.spr_emotionCaptureDesc: This helps Bertrand understand where you are emotionally and respond with care.
translation.spr_uploadingDesc: Your structured practice session is being saved and shared with your mentor.
translation.spr_savedDriveSuccess: Your 15-minute guided practice has been saved to your Google Drive.
translation.spr_savedLocalSuccess: Your practice session was downloaded to your device. Sign in anytime to upload it to Google Drive.
translation.spr_noLoginWarning: All features work without login. Cloud sync is optional.
translation.noPendingReviews: No pending reviews. All caught up!
translation.journeyBeginsDesc: Your path is guided by the Truebadour. Begin with Chapter 1 — Breathing & Grounding.
translation.fullJourney: FULL JOURNEY — UNLOCKS AS YOU PROGRESS
